description: This file defines the internal hash policy traits used in Abseil's container library, including key handling, iterator policies, and memory usage functions.

classes.name: hash_policy_traits
classes.description: Template struct defining hash policy behaviors for containers, including key access, memory management, and iterator policies.

methods.name: space_used
methods.description: Returns the amount of memory used by a slot.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a functor to the key or element, facilitating flexible key access and manipulation.

methods.name: mutable_key
methods.description: Retrieves a mutable reference to the key portion of a slot.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Retrieves the value part of an element, used in map implementations.
